# Package feed access

- No action is needed unless an npm-based tool fails or warns because it cannot access NPM.
- When that happens, configure the affected tool to use the approved upstream feed `https://packagefeedproxy.microsoft.io/npm/`.
- Do not bypass or work around the NPM Minimum Release control.
- If an urgent business need requires a newly published package version, follow the Microsoft Security Policy and use the approved exception process.
